proposed_records.notes: Proposed by Stage D deterministic v0; descriptor 'Professor Tealeaf'; evidence event indices [19]. Branch hints inferred from location 'camp_via_rockie'.

source_events.event_name: Battle the red gnats at the forest edge
outcomes: Thrin Branchborn fires two arrows; the second shot knocks a group of red gnats out of the swarm.
The swarm envelopes Caelynn, but she withstands the stings and takes only minor damage.
Ephanna lands an Eldritch Blast that knocks another cluster out of the swarm, then Misty Steps away and gains temporary health.
Karsemine lands 4 hits with her scimitar and short sword, uses Zephyr Strike to boost movement, and dashes away.
Caelynn casts Thunderwave, splits the swarm in two, and pushes it back 10 feet.

source_events.event_name: The swarm retreats and the party decides to report back
outcomes: The red gnat swarm gives up and heads back into the forest.
Thrin Branchborn and Caelynn move back from the fight.
The team decides they have enough testing and should return to tell the others what they discovered.

source_events.event_name: Stuart leads Bonogo to Stacey in the half-burned building
source_events.location: alley and half-burned building / warehouse in town
outcomes: Stuart guides Bonogo down an alley to a half-burned building where Stacey can be found.
They enter a large warehouse and find children split into two groups with leaders arguing in the middle.
Stacey is revealed as the bugbear girl they were looking for.

source_events.event_name: Stacey argues with the other children
outcomes: Stacey is in a heated argument with the other children.
The other children accuse Stacey of being too bossy.

source_events.event_name: Stuart demands his gold back and threatens Stacey with a dart
outcomes: Bonogo whispers 'you know what to do' and sends Stuart forward.
Stuart demands his gold back from Stacey and accuses her of stealing it.
Stuart draws a dart and threatens Stacey, prompting her to throw her gold pouch at him and storm out.

source_events.event_name: Bonogo plays hide and seek with the children
outcomes: The other children ask Bonogo to play with them instead of continuing the confrontation.
Bonogo agrees to play hide and seek if the children hide first.
Bonogo counts to 20 and leaves the building without making a sound.

source_events.event_name: Bonogo corners Stacey in the next alley
outcomes: Bonogo catches up to Stacey after following her out of the warehouse.
He grabs Stacey and puts a knife to her throat.
Bonogo tells Stacey to stop bullying Stuart or he will come back, then dashes into the shadows.
Stacey runs home shaken.

source_events.event_name: Stafl directs the town workers from a barrel throne
outcomes: The group finds Stafl singing and directing workers from a makeshift throne of barrels on the back of a wagon.
Stafl is overseeing the field preparations as the town works against the approaching forest.

source_events.event_name: The party reports that the forest reacts to the ground
outcomes: Ephanna, Karsemine, and Caelynn report the results of their tests.
They conclude that the town should not attack the trees directly.
They determine that the forest responds to changes on the ground.

source_events.event_name: Marla confronts Bonogo over Stuart
outcomes: A furious Bugbear woman slaps at Bonogo and berates him for encouraging Stuart to harass her daughter.
Bonogo insults her and tells Marla Brambleback to get back to work on the ditches.
Marla Brambleback shouts that he smells like a circus animal and grapples Bonogo.
Stafl hears a farmer warn him that Marla is in charge of the workers and not someone to mess with.

source_events.event_name: Caelynn calms Marla and restores the work effort
outcomes: Marla Brambleback is about to do much worse to Bonogo.
Caelynn uses her bracelet to diffuse the aggression.
The crowd returns to work and unites against the approaching forest.

source_events.event_name: The town's ditch fires turn the forest away
outcomes: The Questionable Company and the townsfolk watch the forest come within range of the plan.
The fires are lit in the ditches as the forest reaches the fortifications.
The trees pull back and turn east, away from town.
The mayor and sheriff congratulate the heroes and thank them again for their help.

source_events.event_name: Caelynn asks about Lysandra and the mayor has never heard of her
source_events.location: town after the forest turns away
outcomes: Marla approaches Caelynn and asks how she should deal with Bonogo.
Ephanna intervenes and tells the town that the Questionable Company is leaving.
Caelynn asks the mayor about Lysandra.
The mayor says they have never heard of Lysandra.

source_events.event_name: Caelynn reaches Sara on the rockie-talkie
outcomes: Caelynn uses the rockie-talkie to call Lysandra and reaches Sara instead.
Sara says she heard only mumbling about the forest leaving and that something strange happened to time.
Sara calls Lysandra and then connects Caelynn directly to her.

source_events.event_name: Caelynn speaks with Lysandra and tells her to rest
outcomes: Lysandra is relieved and overjoyed that the group is safe and that the forest was dealt with.
Lysandra says she cannot remember much after the group left, only that she went around the forest, smelled meat while trying to sleep, and is exhausted and disoriented.
Caelynn tells Lysandra to stop where she is, make camp, and rest while Karsemine leads the team to her.

source_events.event_name: Karesmine tracks Lysandra's route and the party sets out
outcomes: Karesmine uses her tracking skills to estimate the distance and direction Lysandra traveled.
The group leaves town to follow Karesmine's lead.
Ephanna keeps a close eye on Thrin during the trip.

source_events.event_name: The party finds Lysandra by the wagon and crates
source_events.location: a camp with a partly unloaded wagon and crates
outcomes: After thirty minutes, the party discovers a wagon partly unloaded with horses wandering around a stack of crates.
Caelynn hears mumbling from inside the makeshift shelter and finds Lysandra drawing in the dirt.
Lysandra says the drawing is a tower where the voices are coming from and that she knows where it is.

source_events.event_name: Caelynn cures Lysandra of the spell
outcomes: Caelynn notices Lysandra's shimmery eyes, like the members of the cult.
Caelynn prepares an antidote from the tea in her bag while examining the top-down blueprint of a tower drawn in the dirt.
After drinking the tea, Lysandra comes out of the spell and becomes confused about where she is and how she got there.
Lysandra remembers only voices in the dark after the group left into the forest.

source_events.event_name: Stafl finds tainted meat in the provisions
outcomes: Karesmine rounds up the horses and keeps them properly cared for while a storm builds in the distance.
Stafl sorts through the provisions and suspects someone smuggled tainted meat in from Mirathorn.
He finds the bacon untouched but discovers cleverly disguised tainted meat mixed into the jerky crates.
The tainted and untainted meat cannot be separated, so the whole batch will have to be burned.

source_events.event_name: Caelynn reports to Sara and asks for Professor Tealeaf
outcomes: Caelynn tells Sara the good news about Lysandra and the bad news about the tainted meat.
Sara worries about who can now be trusted in the city.
Sara transfers Caelynn to Professor Tealeaf, but Tealeaf does not pick up.
